column1: # ACT_ID=ACT-POLYC-SELFHOST-WP001-DRIVER-TAKEOVER01
# ACT_PHASE=C2-IMPL
# EVIDENCE_KIND=plan-validity-fail-closed
# THE PLAN-VALIDITY EXPERIMENT, AND THE FAIL-OPEN IT FOUND.
# The M-POLYC-POISON-04 experiment poisons the PolyC driver's route
# export and measures whether the C host FAILS CLOSED.
# TWO POISONS WERE MEASURED:
#   P1  the route export returns 77 (OUT OF THE STEP DOMAIN)
#   P2  the plan stays EMPTY, so the route export returns
#       WP_DRIVER_STEP_INVALID (0)
# P1 FAILED CLOSED under the ORIGINAL guard and under the REPAIRED
# guard.
# P2 DID NOT. Under the ORIGINAL guard the C host ACCEPTED route 0,
# because the guard was a pure numeric BOUND check:
#     if (wp_route < 0 || wp_route >= WP_DRIVER_STEP_COUNT)
# and 0 is INSIDE { 0 .. WP_DRIVER_STEP_COUNT-1 }. The host's dispatch
# is a set of POSITIVE equality tests with an IMPLICIT FALL-THROUGH
# to compile, so an empty plan compiled anyway and PRODUCED AN
# ARTIFACT. That is a FAIL-OPEN: the driver selected nothing, and the
# compiler did the work anyway.
# THE REPAIR HAS TWO HALVES, and BOTH are required:
#   R1  the C guard REJECTS WP_DRIVER_STEP_INVALID, so route 0 is no
#       longer inside the accepted domain; and
#   R2  the PolyC driver selects the COMPILE route EXPLICITLY when no
#       option route wins, so a LEGITIMATE argv never produces an
#       empty plan.
# R1 alone would break every ordinary compile (the empty plan is the
# ordinary compile), and R2 alone would leave the fail-open in place
# for a genuinely empty plan. The pair is the fix.
# THE MEASUREMENTS BELOW ARE THE CAUSAL EVIDENCE: the SAME poisoned
# subject, the SAME input file, and the ONLY difference between the
# two rows of each pair is the guard.
# All rows below were produced with a REAL input file
# (/tmp/wp001t/pw/input.HC) and the REAL production compiler. An
# earlier iteration of this experiment was INVALID because the probe
# directory had no input file, so the compiler failed with "Failed to
# open file" instead of exercising the guard. That iteration was
# discarded and re-measured; the rows below are the re-measurement.
experiment
P1-OUT-OF-DOMAIN
P1-OUT-OF-DOMAIN
P2-EMPTY-PLAN
P2-EMPTY-PLAN
# The P2-EMPTY-PLAN ORIGINAL row is the NEGATIVE CONTROL for the
# repair: it is the observation that the original guard did NOT fail
# closed, so the repaired row's FAIL_CLOSED is caused by the guard
# and not by the poison being inert.
# The diagnostic text for the repaired rows is the host's own:
#   ERROR: hcc: the driver selected an invalid route (77)
#   ERROR: hcc: the driver selected an invalid route (0)
# CONSERVATION AFTER THE REPAIR, measured on the repaired tree:
#   PARSER_ASSERTIONS_PASSED
#   PARSER_ASSERTIONS_TOTAL
#   PARSER_FAILED_LINES
#   PARSER_PASSED_BLOCKS
#   PARSER_ASSERTION_SEQUENCE_MD5
#   LEXER07_DIRECT_DIFF_PASS
#   LEXER08_DIRECT_DIFF_PASS
#   LEXER09_DIRECT_DIFF_PASS
#   G0_G1_DIFFERENTIAL
#   GATE_FAST
# NOTE ON THE G0/G1 DIFFERENTIAL. G0 and G1 MUST be built from the
# SAME working-tree state, because --version embeds the build
# metadata. Three cases (D03, D12, D20) disagreed against a G0 that
# was built from an EARLIER tree; the disagreement was the commit
# hash in the --version output, not a semantic difference. Rebuilt
# from the same tree, the differential is 30/30 AGREE.
# CONSERVATION_RULES
